## `nrowP`

*Available in [R](#nrowp-r)*
=== "R"
    !!! bug "Deprecated Function"
        This function has been deprecated, and will be removed in a future CIDAtools release.
    <h4>Description</h4>

    Retrieve the number of rows in dataframe of matrix with commas inserted for
    nice reports.

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    nrowP(x)

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `x` - data frame or matrix

    <h4>Returns</h4>

    Number of rows with big.mark = , and trim = T
